messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@mistralhealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating onboarding into single half-day (console + API)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We have a lot to cover (console walkthrough, API enablement, service account provisioning, and a short ops runbook). Our stakeholders prefer to consolidate the two planned sessions into a single half-day if possible to reduce scheduling overhead.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: Thu Aug 2, 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM
- Option B: Mon Aug 6, 12:00 PM - 4:00 PM

We definitely need a hands-on API deep-dive (including example cURL/SDK flows), and a console demo focused on RBAC and model rollout controls. Please confirm if the half-day works operationally and who will lead each segment. I've attached a brief requirements doc and a list of attendee roles.

Thanks,
Lara Chen
Program Manager, Technical Integrations
Mistral Health

Attachments: mistral_onboard_requirements.pdf
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@mistralhealth.com>
Cc: onboarding@mistralhealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating onboarding into single half-day (console + API)

Hi Lara — great to hear from you. Consolidating into a single half-day is doable, and we can make it efficient with a tight agenda and clear handoffs.

Quick proposal:
- 9:00–9:20: Kickoff & objectives (Ben)
- 9:20–10:25: Console walkthrough (Monica to lead)
- 10:25–10:35: Break
- 10:35–12:00: API enablement + live sample integration (Priyom to lead)
- 12:00–1:00: Q&A, next steps, mutual action plan and follow-up items

If you prefer the afternoon window (Option B), we can shift the same agenda accordingly — Monica and Priyom have some afternoon constraints but can make Aug 6 work with notice. I've attached a draft session agenda (session_agenda_v2.docx) and a Zoom link for the live session.

Two asks from us before the session:
1) A list of 2–3 test accounts (or service account access) we can use during the API portion.
2) A list of attendee roles so we can tailor depth (dev vs. product vs. security).

Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/987654321
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/74219

If that plan looks good I can loop Monica and Priyom to lock in dates and run a preflight 48 hours out.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Consolidating onboarding into single half-day (console + API) — need coverage and preflight owners

Monica / Priyom — forwarding Lara's note and my reply. Proposed half-day agenda above. Can you confirm who owns which sections and any preflight tasks?

Monica: please lead the console walkthrough (RBAC, rollout, observability hooks). Please add 10–15 minutes on tracing/sample logs for their security engineer.
Priyom: please lead the API enablement (service account, SDK sample, streaming demo). We may need a short script to exercise long-running responses — would you be OK baking that into the demo?

Preflight checklist items to confirm:
- Mistral service account (or temp test creds) provisioned and shared to redwood-infra@redwood.com (secure transfer).
- SSO/SAML test users for console preview (if available).
- Network allowlist for Zoom and our testing endpoints.

Attachments: preflight_checklist.pdf

Can you both reply with availability for Aug 2 and Aug 6 and list any hard blocks? I want to lock this with Lara today.

Thanks — Ben
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@mistralhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Consolidating onboarding into single half-day (console + API) — need coverage and preflight owners

Ben / Priyom — I can take the console portion. Aug 2 (morning) works for me; Aug 6 I only have 12–2 blocked for another customer, so we'd need to shift if we choose Option B.

I will add a short security-focused trace/logs section and confirm the RBAC demo script. Priyom — if you can drop a short API smoke-test script into the shared drive by Friday that would be ideal.

Lara — quick note: can you confirm whether SSO test users will be available? If not, we'll demo via a temporary admin user and call out exact steps. Also please share the attendee list (roles) so I can trim/expand the demo.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Thread status: waiting on Mistral to confirm attendee list and service account creds; internal owners assigned: Monica (console), Priyom (API).]
